        How to: Create Screen Control Grid Columns
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Shared
 > How to: Create Screen Control Grid Columns
    
    
    
        The SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS table allows for dynamic metadata configuration of various grid values, such as columns, column headings, column types. Please note that to create a new insight screen or add columns to an existing grid, currently C# code is required for the model in addition to updating or inserting SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS records. Please review the How to: Create the Grid Model topic for more information.

 


    For information on how to tie an event to the grid column see the How to: Create Screen Control Events topic.



     Step 1: Create select columns



    Add a SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS record for each column that should be in the grid as follows. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    
        
            
                Field

                Value
            

            
                FIELD

                The literal field name or aggregate value that will be executed as part of SQL query. For example, this could be something like "sum(On_Hand_Qty)".
            

            
                FIELD_NAME

                The alias for the FIELD. If the FIELD is "sum(On_Hand_Qty)" and the FIELD_NAME is ON_HAND_QTY, then the query for the column will be rendered "sum(On_Hand_Qty) as ON_HAND_QTY".
            

            
                FIELD_TYPE

                The column type. The full enumeration of available field types can be found in the "Metadata Field Types" configuration.
            

            
                FIELD_WIDTH

                The default width of the column in the grid. Use null to specify that column should be "auto sized" based on the largest value in the column (header text or actual row values). Use integer value to specify an actual column width in pixels. The value will be overridden if the user changes the column width manually from the screen itself.
            

            
                RESOURCE_KEY

                The resource key for the header text of the column.
            

            
                SCREEN_CONTROL_ID

                The Object of the grid screen control the column is tied to.
            

            
                SEQUENCE

                Used to determine the default order of the columns in the grid. This will be overridden if the user changes the column order manually.
            

            
                SQL_CLAUSE_TYPE

                20 (Select)
            

            
                DECIMAL_POSITIONS

                Used to define what "Decimal Positions" configuration record the column should use.
            

            
                HIDDEN

                Used to default a column to hidden.
            

            
                COLUMN_TEMPLATE

                Used to define templating for grid columns. Please reference http://www.igniteui.com/grid/column-template for more information.
            

            
                IS_PRIMARY_KEY

                Determines whether or not the column is the primary key for the grid. This is required if the "delete" option will be enabled in the grid. Only one primary key should be specified per grid.
            

            
                ALLOW_SORT

                Determines whether or not the column can be sorted. Default value is Y. Set to N to turn off sorting for the column.
            
        
    



     Step 2: Create where columns



    Extra filters on a query can either be processed directly by creating or modifying the SQL view that a grid is tied to, or by creating SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS records. To add extra conditions that always apply to the search query, add a SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS record for each extra condition as follows. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    

    
        
            
                Field

                Value
            

            
                FIELD

                The extra condition to apply to the query. For example, this could be something like "On_Hand_Qty > 0".
            

            
                FIELD_NAME

                NULL
            

            
                FIELD_TYPE

                NULL
            

            
                FIELD_WIDTH

                NULL
            

            
                RESOURCE_KEY

                NULL
            

            
                SCREEN_CONTROL_ID

                The Object of the grid screen control the column is tied to.
            

            
                SEQUENCE

                NULL
            

            
                SQL_CLAUSE_TYPE

                40 (Where)
            

            
                DECIMAL_POSITIONS

                NULL
            

            
                HIDDEN

                NULL
            
        
    



     Step 3: Create group by columns



    Please see the How to: Default the Group By Column in a Grid for instructions.



     Step 4: Create order by columns



    Please see the How to: Default the Order By Column in a Grid for instructions.



            
            See Also
How to: Add a Grid to an Insight List Pane
